The older design lists `emg-cp01`, while the canonical plan requires `emg-cp02` and `emg-mg04`; `emg-cp01` is covered transitively through `emg-cp02`.

**Scoped checks passed:** proof layout (24 steps, 0 defects), precheck (5 proof-bearing items, 0 failures), strict proof contracts, rendering, content policy, and focused dependency, forward-reference, external-reference, and source-fetch checks. Coverage records four full-text documents, including the [Colin–Watanabe paper](https://www.math.u-bordeaux.fr/~mcolin/cauchy_maxKG.pdf) and [Friedrich–Rendall lecture notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0002074).

**Owner blockers:** the full-run item-level check finds 54 empty inventories and 28 stale levels outside this batch. The shared batch-level digest is stale; its recomputed row remains level 3 with requirements `[4, 6, 7]`. Full-run contract coverage stops at the unrelated empty page `emg-mm03`.
